info.name: CRM
info.description:
Every endpoint of the CRM API, in the order the business uses them: sign in, people and roles, companies and contacts, leads, the pipeline, quotations, orders, customers, delivery (projects, tasks), service (tickets, contracts), payments, then documents, notifications, dashboard, reports, audit log, settings and search.

Set userEmail and userPassword in the environment to an account with full access (npm run create:admin). Requests sign in by themselves when there is no token. Created ids are saved to the environment by the test scripts and used by later requests, so the collection can be run from top to bottom. The last folder, Cleanup, deletes what was created.
